option_relations.rationale: The option describes a mixed phenotype leukemia, which is distinct from the Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-ALL in the leaf.

This option is clinically equivalent to the provided leaf, both describing Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia, which is a common way to refer to B-ALL with Philadelphia chromosome.
The option describes Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia in Lymphoid Blast Crisis, which is a different diagnosis from Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-ALL.
